registered_by: committed to git before any evaluation was run; the commit timestamp is the proof
hypothesis: The sign of the pooled lag-1 autocorrelation of non-overlapping 12-hour returns, estimated across BTC/ETH/SOL over the trailing 20 windows, predicts the DIRECTION of the next 12-hour return better than chance.
why_this_horizon: In the discovery sample (208 days, 1h bars) the trend/reversion polarity agreed across all three assets in 7 of 7 monthly blocks (p~6e-5), and over the last four weeks the 12h horizon read +0.39/+0.23/+0.37 while 1h and 4h read approximately zero. 12h is where the regime was visible.

rule.stride_note: each cycle is 12 trailing bars then 12 forward bars, so no window shares a bar with any other
rule.estimator: Pearson r between trailing 12h return and forward 12h return, POOLED across the three assets over the trailing K windows
rule.side: sign(r) * sign(trailing 12h return)  — follow the trailing move when r > 0, fade it when r < 0
rule.no_trade_when: |r| < 0.15, or the estimate has fewer than K complete windows, or the trailing return is exactly zero

success_criterion: accuracy strictly greater than 50% with a one-sided binomial p < 0.05
secondary_metric: mean signed basis points per prediction, net of a 9.4bp round-trip cost (4.5bp taker fee plus half a ~0.4bp spread, each way)
falsified_if: net basis points per prediction <= 0 once n >= 200
selection_disclosure: K=20 and the 0.15 gate were the best of a THIRTY-configuration sweep on the discovery data, where they scored 56.4% (n=365). The forward test therefore tests that selected configuration as a whole, which is the entire point: a number chosen as the best of thirty is exactly the kind that needs fresh data to survive.
stopping_rule: The schedule accumulates regardless of interim results. No claim is made, in either direction, before n >= 200. There is no early stop for a good result.
amendment_policy: No parameter above may be changed. Any change is a NEW pre-registration with a new id, and the old one keeps its record.
known_weaknesses: Crypto majors are highly correlated, so pooling three of them is nearer to three noisy readings of one series than to three independent samples. The effective n is smaller than the nominal n, and the binomial test does not know that.
208 days is one market era. A regime structure that held through it may simply not exist in another.
12h windows accrue at 2 per asset per day, so n >= 200 takes roughly 33 days of collection.
